operation: Zoho Inventory item thumbnail upload via official item image API

blocker.summary: Netlify secret environment variables are masked in UI and CLI outside Netlify runtime. The local uploader cannot decrypt the encrypted Zoho token bundle or refresh/access the Zoho API without real unmasked runtime values.

nextSafeOptions: Run the existing uploader with a real unmasked local env file supplied out-of-band and kept ignored.
Add a narrowly scoped server-side intranet image-upload function and run it in a Netlify context where the existing secrets are available, after explicit approval for that deployment path.
Use Zoho API credentials from a secure secret manager or direct local environment variable injection without printing or committing them.
